notes:
Summary: evaluating Redwood Private/Dedicated for large-scale RAG on legal/compliance docs. Primary goals: high-quality embeddings + reranking to cut manual review time and reduce downstream review costs. Index target: 15-30M OCRed docs (mix of PDF, TIFF, DOCX).

Performance & cost targets (customer stated):
- Latency SLOs: p50 rerank < 200ms, p95 end-to-end < 500ms (query + reranker).
- Throughput: sustained 50-100 QPS with spikes to 200 QPS for discovery windows.
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants clear cost-per-query and committed capacity pricing.

Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer open weights and quantization-friendly stacks (Llama2 / Mistral variants) for on-prem control.
- Want automatic fallback to smaller, cheaper model for low-priority queries.
- Reranker to run as fast path (GPU) with cache for frequent prefixes.

Security / compliance needs (callouts):
- VPC/private control plane mandatory. "We can't have doc content leaving our VPC."
- KMS-managed customer keys, HSM option asked for.
- Audit logging with immutable retention and ability to support 7-year legal hold — "7-year legal hold is non-negotiable."
- US-only data residency (initial), potential EU expansion later.

POC scope / success criteria (agreed in tech deep-dive):
- Ingest 20M doc sample (OCR pipeline + metadata normalization).
- Embedding recall@10 target > 0.85 on internal eval set.
- Reranker improves precision@5 by >=12% vs dense-only baseline.
- Latency: p50 rerank <200ms on production-like load.
- Cost target: <$0.05 per end-to-end query (target to be validated).

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Jordan) — sent high-level deck + requested NDA.
- 2026-01-22: NDA executed; security questionnaire in progress.
- 2026-02-04: Technical deep-dive (Riley) — ingestion, OCR, expected index size, storage layout.
- 2026-02-18: Sent POC scope + ingest plan for 20M docs; asked for Redwood sizing options.
- 2026-02-24: Security call w/ Lexoria InfoSec — asked for audit log retention specifics and KMS flow diagrams.
- 2026-03-05: POC kickoff; agreed deliverables: sizing, cost estimates, quantization recommendations, on-prem pilot plan.

Quotes & color: "We need absolute proof we can meet legal hold and audit log retention before procurement." / "Cost per query will determine whether we do dedicated or fully private on-prem."

Open items & assumptions:
- Clarify support for immutable audit log export to customer SIEM and length of time logs are stored in control plane.
- Confirm network topology requirements for on-prem connectors (eg firewall rules, egress restrictions).
- Provide detailed committed capacity sizing for both GPU and CPU paths + expected token/sec numbers.

Next actions (short):
- Redwood to deliver three sizing/cost options (cloud-private, dedicated reserved, on-prem pilot) by 2026-03-12.
- Schedule infra review with Lexoria network team (Jordan + Riley + infrastructure SMEs) week of 2026-03-15.
- Identify legal contact for contract clause on legal-hold retention and audit log custody.
